claims.summary: Over a field, for R=k[x], axioms a_j, a filtered R-module N (any generators and relations) with a degree-D pseudo-submodule J_N, errors E_i, protected w and nu in F_K N with b+K<=D and deg(wE_i)+K<=D, call nu a module repair when a_j m nu in J_N for deg(a_j m)<=D-K, w E_i nu in J_N and w nu not in J_N. Maps compatible with multiplication modulo J_N are multiplication by nu modulo J_N. If a linear beta from F_D N into a filtered commutative algebra S carries J_N into J' (closed under each phi(x_i)), is compatible up to a k-algebra map phi:R->S with degree bounds, and beta(w nu) is not in J', then beta(nu) is an S-valued repair of the phi-image system; for S=R and phi the identity a scalar repair of the old system at no larger degree; free modules with matrix-preimage closures yield (B nu)_l at parameter K; for N=R/I the certificates are f with If in J' modulo J'. First-order differential certificates g->g+eps dg into R[eps]/eps^2 with target J+eps J, J the old closure with Boolean axioms on the differentiated variables, soundness reaching them and degree room, yield f0 or f1 as a scalar repair on the window deg(a_j m)<=D-K. Every repair puts w outside the degree-(D-K) closure of the axioms with the weighted errors wE_i added.
claims.assessment: Working proof passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer with two follow-ups (review record in research/results/common_multiplier_module_repair_20261016); the J+eps J collapse is the reviewer's suggestion, proved in the entry and checked by it.
claims.rationale: Shows the module/matrix enlargement of repair adds nothing when survival is certified R-linearly from the old closure, and restates the extended hardness otherwise; leaves certificates through non-R-linear maps such as substitutions.
claims.next_action: Module repairs into a twisted free module M_rho at n=2, k=2, rho(x_1), rho(x_2) commuting and not simultaneously triangularizable, on a closure that is not an ideal truncation.
